description: Presidential Secretariat - Order made to declare that the Areas of Land called E - Dallawatta in Kulipitiya D/S/D Polgahawela, Kurunegala District to be a licensed zones for the purpose of Greater Colombo Economic Commission Law (Board of Investment Law) No. 04 of 1978
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring areas as licensed zones through detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and survey plans. It involves land allocation and zoning for economic purposes under the Board of Investment Law, focusing on property definitions rather than government personnel changes, structural adjustments, or other specialized categories.
